test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Amit is also a __chip off the old block__ like his brother, Tandon.

options.text: getting ready for the future endeavours
talking to others tough like a stone
resembling his parents in character and appearance

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"chip off the old block"** means someone who closely resembles their parent in character or appearance.
 
• This idiom is commonly used to highlight similarities between a parent and child.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 3 do not convey this meaning.
 
• Option 4,** "resembling his parents in character and appearance,"** accurately captures the essence of the idiom.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Amit is also a **chip off the old block** like his brother, Tandon."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "getting ready for the future endeavours"** – This does not relate to the idiom "chip off the old block."
 
• **B: "planning things ahead neatly"** – This also does not capture the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **C: "talking to others tough like a stone"** – This is unrelated to the idiom's meaning.
 
• **D: "resembling his parents in character and appearance"** – This correctly captures the essence of the idiom.
